raw.query: SELECT c.run_id, c.window_name, c.quantile, c.lead_s, c.numerator_worker_seconds, c.denominator_kind, c.denominator_run, c.denominator_worker_seconds, c.denominator_workers, c.denominator_window, c.denominator_window_mismatch, c.cost_ratio, l.p99_ms AS encoder_p99_ms, l.n_requests, c.is_current FROM provenance.v_cost_ratio AS c LEFT JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency AS l ON l.run_id = c.run_id AND l.window_name = c.window_name AND l.pool = 'encoder' AND l.is_current = true WHERE c.is_current = true AND c.run_id ~ '^rerun_verify:react_p90_W(120|240|480)_.+_L30$' AND c.denominator_kind = 'deployable_static_c8' ORDER BY c.window_name, c.run_id;
